symptom.meaning: PowerShell/native wrapper terminated without a real docker/bash status; NOT a Docker affinity failure and NOT pass_product

647783.title: Retry Docker e2e after dockerignore fix (r2)
647783.note: Aborted mid build-context transfer (~2.18GB); status=aborted. Distinct from -1; context bloat / host abort.

512849.title: Start e2e r3 redirected to log
512849.note: Exclusive *> redirect held console-r3.log; later killed during storm stop → -1.

791183.title: Run ONE bounded e2e-docker r3
791183.smoking_gun: out-file IOException: console-r3.log is being used by another process; FINAL_LASTEXITCODE=-1
791183.note: Concurrent Tee-Object onto the same path already locked by 512849 *> redirect.

512850.title: Run e2e r4 with fixed dockerignore
512850.note: Host wrapper reported -1 after ~36s while orphaned bake/attack continued writing console-r4.log; storm + exclusive redirect / process loss.

root_cause.detail: Two or more host wrappers launched e2e against a shared console-rN.log. Exclusive *> redirection and Tee-Object/Out-File cannot share the file; PowerShell raises IOException and surfaces LASTEXITCODE=-1 (unsigned 4294967295).
contributing: fixed console log paths instead of unique RUN_ID logs
manual Stop-Process also yields 4294967295 when killing a locked wrapper
not_root_cause: Docker Desktop affinity (engine 578836b2… / npipe desktop-linux repeatedly OK)
dockerignore alone (necessary for context size; not the -1 exit)

behaviors: single-flight mutex under .agent-runs/e2e/single-flight.lock (second launch EXIT 2 refuse-closed)
Start-Transcript append instead of exclusive *> / shared Tee-Object
preserve real bash scripts/e2e-docker.sh exit code

prior_real_docker_progress_when_launcher.note: Attack 70/70 + gate-e2e PASSed before pass-wargame FAIL; proves Desktop docker path can run when wrapper does not die with -1. Still NOT pass_product_clean_room.

next: Use scripts/e2e-docker-launch.ps1 for ONE bounded Desktop attempt; Cap free=false; product=0 until pass_product_clean_room measured; AUTH/AT still Root
